literal: Every time intoxicated liquor drinking is desired like that indeed love becoming public every time is sweet.
translation: Just as drinking liquor is desired more with every wave of intoxication, love grows sweeter every time it becomes public knowledge.
modern: கள் குடித்து போதை ஏற ஏற மீண்டும் அதைக் குடிக்க விரும்புவது போல, காதல் ஊருக்குத் தெரிய வரும்போதெல்லாம் அது இனிமையாகவே இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet compares the public discovery of a secret romance to the drinking of liquor. Just as a person who drinks liquor desires it more with every wave of intoxication, the lovers find their passion growing sweeter every time a new rumor spreads about them. The word 'களித்தொறும்' shows the escalating nature of the joy, while 'வெளிப்படுந்தோறும்' links the sweetness directly to the public exposure of their love.
